- Week 1 end (Vivek): automated regression run vs canonical prompt set (100 prompts) — metric: top-level quality delta (perplexity + task specific F1 for summarization).
- Week 2 (Olga): INT8/INT4 quant runs + kernel profile traces (per-layer latency, memory).
- Week 2 end (Marissa): synthesis report, risk items, final close call with Acme.

Deliverables: perf matrices, quant-kernel-profiles-INT8-INT4.csv, regression-summary.pdf, suggested config for Dedicated pool and rollout advice. Proposed close date: Fri 14 May (pending procurement).

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:11:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff — performance validation scope

Quick status update:
- Baseline FP16/BF16 runs complete for chat + summarization + embeddings at concurrencies 8/32/128.
  - Chat (seq=1k tokens): median latency 85ms @8, 230ms @32, 980ms @128. TTFT improvement with batching observed on BF16 for chat-heavy traffic.
  - Summarization batch (batch=16): throughput 120 reqs/min FP16, 130 reqs/min BF16.
  - Embeddings stream: steady 16k tokens/s @8 GPUs.
- Automated regression run (Vivek): initial quality deltas within tolerance for INT8 on chat, but INT4 shows a 6% ROUGE-L drop on summarization canonical set (exceeds threshold).
- Olga: kernel traces indicate INT4 shifts attention kernel runtime distribution — small layers become memory-bound.

Action items this week:
1) Olga to produce the kernel-profile CSV + short note on mitigation (mixed-precision fallback for sensitive layers).
2) Vivek to run a targeted eval with wider prompt set (n=300) to confirm regression scope.
3) Marissa to prepare MAP one-pager for procurement.

Karthik
Lead Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff — performance validation scope

Sarah/Tom — finalizing the close-playbook for the MAP. Summary and decisions below; PDF one-pager attached (MAP-timeline-v1.pdf).

Executive summary:
- Baselines (FP16/BF16) are within SLOs at target concurrencies.
- INT8 showed acceptable quality/cost tradeoffs for chat and embeddings; INT4 reduced inference cost but produced regressions for summarization (ROUGE-L -6% on canonical set).
- Kernel profiles show INT4 increases relative kernel variance; mitigation: selective mixed-precision (INT4 for large attention blocks, BF16 fallbacks for small layers).

Close plan & timeline:
- Tue 11 May: Vivek runs extended regression (n=300) to validate the scope of INT4 regressions (owner: Vivek).
- Wed 12 May: Engineering decision on rollout config (selective mixed-precision) (owner: Karthik).
- Thu 13 May: Deliver final perf pack + sanitized traces to Acme S3 (owner: Olga).
- Fri 14 May: Close call — procurement & product sign-off (owner: Marissa).

Acceptance criteria (go/no-go):
- Latency SLOs met for chat at concurrency 32 (median <= 250ms).
- Summarization ROUGE-L regression <= -2% for any quant variant chosen.
- Traces delivered and sanitized to Acme encrypted bucket.

Please confirm if Fri 14 May still works for procurement sign-off and if the acceptance thresholds need adjusting. We'll hold the final rollout decision until Wed.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-timeline-v1.pdf, redwood_perf_map_v2.xlsx
